subject: PDF only shows the first page

messages.name: Gringotts Financial admin
messages.body: Client says the PDF we sent is missing items.

messages.name: Priya (Support)
messages.body: This is BUG-2310-02 (High, open): invoices with more than 25 line items export as a single-page PDF. Send the invoice by email link instead; the online view and the portal show every line. Or keep invoices to 25 lines or fewer.
